subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: What public Plugin SDK correlation contract should OpenClaw expose for trace identity across agent, message, compaction, and subagent hooks?
rationale: The remaining work changes public plugin API semantics and privacy boundaries across several hook families, so automation cannot safely choose field names, hook ownership, or rollout order without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve narrow additive contract
options.body: Add a single documented correlation shape, reuse DiagnosticTraceContext where possible, and land small compatibility-preserving slices across the affected hooks.

options.title: Split by canonical issues
options.body: Keep #50291 as the umbrella but require #80551 and #18571 to land first so agent-start and outbound evidence semantics settle independently.

options.title: Limit to existing contexts
options.body: Decline first-class aliases and require plugins to use only current ctx.runId, ctx.trace, and sessionKey, accepting incomplete outbound and subagent run correlation.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow additive contract
recommendation.body: Add a single documented correlation shape, reuse DiagnosticTraceContext where possible, and land small compatibility-preserving slices across the affected hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the closest outbound hook correlation slice and is tied to current-source routing for the affected hook/outbound contract surface.
